messages:
marta-cs: Hey team — Arkwell (contact: @elaine.arkwell) just asked to onboard a custom ensemble: 7B reranker + 13B summarizer. Key constraints: PHI handling, on-prem HSM for keys, and ability to run evals against their 2k-case testset. They want a timeline for evals + production readiness. Also flagged renewal risk if this slips past EOY. Quick sync?

devon-se: Sounds like a Dedicated or Private deployment. Any size estimate on qps/latency? Also need data residency (they're EU). :eyes:

marta-cs: Initial ask: 30 qps peak, 10 qps sustained, low latency (<300ms for rerank prefix). EU data residency required. They prefer Private (VPC) w/ HSM. Budget is TBD — could be an upsell to Dedicated.

liam-ml: OK. For the ensemble, we'll need to run safety evals and PHI redaction tests. Suggest baseline eval plan: 1) redaction recall/precision on their 2k set, 2) hallucination/regression checks on 500 prompts, 3) latency/cost sim on 10k tokens. Can we get the dataset (S3 link) and an NDA for PHI?

marta-cs: They can share S3 link but asked for KMS/HSM attestation first. I've started the security questionnaire. @devon-se can you confirm if Private + HSM attestation can be delivered within 2 weeks?

devon-se: We can do attestation but on-prem HSM installs will need infra lead and a scoping call. 2 weeks is tight but possible for VPC + KMS keys. On-prem air-gapped HSM will be longer (4–6 wks). Let's schedule a scoping call with Arkwell.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket CS-4821 for Arkwell onboard. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/CS-4821 :calendar:

marta-cs: Thanks — I'll book scoping call for tomorrow 3pm CET. @liam-ml please prep an eval runbook and Docker recipe we can use in their VPC (quantization/FP16 notes). Also add rollback/fallback to smaller model if perf issues.

liam-ml: Will do. Drafting runbook now — will attach to CS-4821 by EOD. Quick Q: do we have a recommended quant config for 13B summarizer in Private with EU region GPUs?

devon-se: Recommend 4-bit QAT (GPTQ) if latency matters, otherwise int8 looks stable. I'll add hardware profile suggestions to the ticket.

marta-cs: Perfect. Note: renewal touchpoint flagged — if Arkwell wants Private w/ HSM, it's a clear upgrade opportunity. I'll assign AM to start contract prep after scoping.
